opinions.text: October 25, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied. Mr. C. S. Littleton and' Mr. Jesse M. Littleton for 'petitioner. Mr. Assistant Attorney General Stewart and Mr. H. S. Ridgely for the United States.
